singleton_scope.protected_decision: Whether the first A-long quality / cashflow / balance-sheet / earnings-stability search produces a research-only alpha clue after the data route passed fixed-panel audit.
applies_to: The future reviewed A-long main-board signal-search execution package that may be executed only after independent review and user execute.
does_not_authorize: No signal-search run is authorized by this ledger before independent review and an explicit user execute command.
No fixed 9-symbol panel alpha claim, no production use, no ship-gate evidence, no full-size manual use, no provider expansion, no DataHub work, and no broker / order automation.

creation_reason.reason: The fixed-panel A-long data-integrity audit passed and permits the next preregistration step only. A singleton ledger prevents silent parameter rescue, fixed-panel alpha overclaim, or unreviewed signal execution.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first reviewed A-long signal-search execution spends one planned test regardless of pass, risk-filter-only, or fail result.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: If the future result fails or is risk-filter-only, do not rerun with changed signal families, thresholds, holding periods, benchmark, universe, cost model, or industry policy without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.

test_spend_log.allowed_followup: No rerun, threshold change, family change, horizon change, benchmark change, or rescue slicing without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update. Positive clues remain research-only until forward-live ship-gate evidence exists.

next_required_actions: Do not rerun or rescue this A-long signal search without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.
If the result is no-alpha, treat it as failed under the frozen rules.
If the result is a research clue, route it to forward-live validation; do not treat it as production or ship-gate evidence.
